title: Roadmap trajectory mapping and executive decision ledger for upcoming QBR
creator: Priya Raman
description: Assemble a focused executive deliverable that maps the next two-quarter product trajectory (hosted, dedicated, private) to decision milestones, required bets, and contingency lanes. Deliverables: 1) a 6-slide executive deck with a timeline/trajectory heatmap, 2) a decision ledger for execs with owners and 'go/no-go' triggers, and 3) an appendix of SLO/cost tradeoffs and dependencies for engineering. Goal: give leadership clear calls-to-action and ask(s) for resource commitments at the QBR.
acceptance_criteria: Executive deck approved by Head of Product and CTO with no more than two rounds of edits
Decision ledger lists discrete decisions, owners, deadlines, and rollback triggers for all top-5 roadmap items
All dependent engineering metrics (latency SLO delta, cost-per-token delta) populated with source links and sign-off from infra leads
